mapper.select: select p.id, a.id as assetId, a.name as itemName, p.server_port, p.link_asset_name, p.link_ip, p.link_status, i.id alarmId from asset a left join asset_app_server p on a.id = p.asset_id left join alarm_info i on a.id = i.asset_id and i.alarm_flag like ('%_' || p.server_port || '_' || p.link_ip) and i.status = 1 and i.alarm_state = 1 where a.watch = 1 and a.is_del = 1 and a.asset_mode = 183 and a.service_type = 1 and a.collection_type = 0

select p.id, a.id as assetId, a.name as itemName, p.server_port, p.link_asset_name, p.link_ip, p.link_status, i.id alarmId from asset a left join asset_app_server p on a.id = p.asset_id left join alarm_info i on a.id = i.asset_id and i.alarm_flag like ('%_' || p.server_port || '_' || p.link_ip) and i.status = 1 and i.alarm_state = 1 where a.watch = 1 and a.is_del = 1 and a.asset_mode = 183 and a.service_type = 1 and a.collection_type = 0 and a.id = #{assetId}
